$comment: What each supported provider runs in the smoke matrix. `env` names the variables its profile reads and `secrets` the ones that are keys (scrubbed from every log); `create` adds create and run flags; `labels: false` marks providers whose sandboxes carry no labels (gc cannot see them); `exceptions` maps a check to the written reason it may fail, reported as restricted instead of fail.

exceptions.network: Daytona tier 1 and 2 orgs have restricted egress that a sandbox cannot override; only essential services such as package registries and git hosts are reachable (https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/network-limits/)
